title: Open image modal on thumbnail click
description: Verify that clicking a visible image thumbnail opens the full-size image in a modal dialog.
steps_actions:
1. "Navigate to the page containing the image thumbnail."

2. "Verify the thumbnail is visible."

3. "Click on the image thumbnail."
steps_result:
1. "A modal dialog appears centered on the screen."

2. "The modal displays the full-size version of the clicked image."

3. "A close button (X) is present and functional."

title: Open correct image from gallery thumbnail
description: Verify that clicking a specific thumbnail in a gallery opens the corresponding full-size image.
steps_actions:
1. "Open the image gallery page."

2. "Identify the second image thumbnail in the gallery."

3. "Click on the second thumbnail."
steps_result:
1. "A modal dialog appears displaying the full-size version of the selected image."

2. "The displayed image matches the thumbnail that was clicked."

title: Clicking disabled image does not open modal
description: Verify that clicking a disabled or placeholder image does not open a modal.
steps_actions:
1. "Navigate to a page where an image placeholder is displayed (e.g., image failed to load)."

2. "Confirm the placeholder has a disabled visual state."

3. "Click on the placeholder image."
steps_result:
1. "No modal dialog appears."

2. "The UI remains unchanged and no error message is shown."

title: Handle image click with network offline
description: Verify the application handles a click on an image when the network is unavailable, without crashing.
steps_actions:
1. "Turn off network connectivity (e.g., enable airplane mode)."

2. "Navigate to the page with the image thumbnail."

3. "Click on the image thumbnail."
steps_result:
1. "An error message or fallback UI is displayed indicating the image could not be loaded."

2. "The application remains responsive; no crash or unhandled exception occurs."
